description: A beautiful but strenuous 9.4 km hike up Shass Mountain from Grassham Lake. Trail starts off gradual from the lake but becomes steep as you climb the mountain. Trailhead access is by boat only from the Grassham Lake Recreation Site.
directions: Turn onto the Sowchea Bay Road from Hwy 27 just south of Fort St James. Drive 5 km on the Sowchea Bay Road from the intersection of Hwy 27, turn left onto the Cunningham Forest Service Road (900 Rd). Turn left onto Grassham Forest Service Road at (9)45km and continue for another 1.5 km to site. Trailhead is at the west end of the Lake and is accessible only by boat.
title: Shass Mtn Trail
